A source-first learning path

  1. 1 · ReadOne explanation at a time in English or Chinese.
  2. 2 · InspectSee the deterministic SVG and its text equivalent.
  3. 3 · CheckTry three questions and trace every answer to a source.
  4. 4 · KeepOpen a complete offline pack with no network dependency.

What this demo does not claim

Practice is not certification. The app does not write CourseJesus learner scores or the LEARNED authority. It does not generate video, call a remote model, or present practice as an official course grade.
